verdict.rationale: Elastic documents alerting rules on log aggregation thresholds and at service, environment and transaction levels, or via custom KQL queries. Notifications can go out through services or third-party incident management systems, which loosely covers routing. Nothing in the pack documents grouping or silencing (snooze or maintenance windows) of notifications. Missing for 10: notification grouping, silencing/muting, explicit routing rules, alerting on every signal type (traces, metrics, synthetics), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications

citations.quote: You can create a rule to send an alert when the log aggregation exceeds a threshold.
You can define rules at different levels (service, environment, transaction) or use custom KQL queries.
You can also extend your alerts with notifications via services or third-party incident management systems.
